crops.name: Crop Agronomic Requirements
crops.description: Baseline agronomic requirements for 10 prominent Kerala crops.

source_info.manual_export_instructions: Refer to KAU Package of Practices for Crops. Verify crops, textures, drainage, and pH bounds.
source_info.license_or_terms: Open Government Data (OGD) India / Public Educational

data_quality_limitations: Covers 10 major crops; micro-climatic variety variations within crops are not yet disaggregated.
pH ranges represent general agronomic guidelines rather than crop-variety-specific tolerances.

soil.name: Kerala District Soil Profile
soil.description: Representative soil orders, textures, and qualitative fertility classes across Kerala districts.

source_info.organization: Department of Soil Survey & Soil Conservation, Govt. of Kerala
source_info.manual_export_instructions: Visit Kerala Soil Fertility portal or Kerala Soil Survey report, export soil series/district profiles.
source_info.license_or_terms: Open Government Data (OGD) India / Public Educational

columns.name: ph_category
columns.description: Qualitative pH status (e.g. Strongly acidic, Near neutral)

data_quality_limitations: Contains qualitative pH and fertility categories rather than quantitative laboratory test figures.
District coverage currently has 13 of 14 districts (Pathanamthitta district is absent in initial dataset).
Values reflect regional soil series benchmarks, not farm-specific spot soil samples.

soil_crop_suitability_v2.name: Soil-Crop Compatibility Matrix (Heuristic v2)
soil_crop_suitability_v2.description: Rule-based compatibility scoring combining soil texture, drainage, and estimated pH compatibility.

source_info.license_or_terms: Open Government Data (OGD) India / Public Educational

data_quality_limitations: Scores are derived from rule-based heuristic formulas, NOT statistically trained or field-calibrated ML models.
Estimated pH scores rely on midpoint mappings of qualitative descriptions.

weather.name: Historical Meteorological Observations
weather.description: Daily rainfall, temperature min/max, and relative humidity for Kerala districts.

source_info.organization: NASA Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER)
source_info.manual_export_instructions: Open NASA POWER Data Access Viewer, choose Meteorology/Agroclimatology, select representative Kerala district coordinates and the required date range, then export PRECTOTCORR, T2M_MIN, T2M_MAX, and RH2M as CSV.
source_info.license_or_terms: Open Government Data (OGD) India / Public Educational

data_quality_limitations: Gridded satellite-reanalysis estimates (~0.5 deg resolution); not direct ground weather-station observations.
processing_steps: Retrieved 4,102 source records from NASA POWER daily point API (AG community) for 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-20.
Preserved the 14 original full-period provider JSON responses and independent response-window rechecks under data/raw/weather/.
Quarantined 25 rainfall records outside the schema bounds verbatim; details are in data/metadata/weather_validation_anomalies_20260101_20261020_20261025182620.csv.
Merged 4,077 schema-valid new daily observations with the existing records; final canonical dataset validates with 60,329 records through 2026-10-20.
Provider metadata confirms PRECTOTCORR mm/day, T2M_MIN/T2M_MAX C, RH2M percent, NASA POWER API v2.10.1, and LST.

crop_yield.name: Historical Crop Yield and Production Statistics
crop_yield.description: Historical crop area, production, and productivity across Kerala districts.

source_info.organization: Department of Economics and Statistics (DES), Govt. of Kerala
source_info.manual_export_instructions: Visit DES Kerala Agricultural Statistics or data.desagri.gov.in, navigate to District-wise Crop Area & Production Reports, export CSV.
source_info.license_or_terms: Open Government Data (OGD) India / Public Educational

data_quality_limitations: Yield figures represent district aggregated averages and may not reflect specific parcel yield variations.
processing_steps: Ingested from DES Kerala portal (ecostat.kerala.gov.in/dataset/28) on 2026-10-25 13:01:54
Raw copy preserved in data/raw/crop_yield/des_kerala_agriculture_statistics.csv
Normalized crop nomenclature (e.g. Paddy -> Rice, Pepper -> Black pepper)
Normalized area to hectares, production to MT, and derived yield kg/ha where missing
Retained 6,422 standardized observations (2001-02 to 2023-24)

columns.description: Currency and weight basis, e.g. INR/quintal

processing_steps: Created CSV template at data/raw/market_prices/market_prices_template.csv
Awaiting user-supplied official export from Agmarknet or Data.gov.in

cultivation_cost_summary.name: Kerala State-Level Cultivation Cost Summary
cultivation_cost_summary.description: Transcribed statewide seasonal and annual input-cost and output-value summary rows.

source_info.organization: Department of Economics & Statistics, Government of Kerala
source_info.manual_export_instructions: Transcribed summary subset supplied in the GROW data enrichment pack; verify against the original reports before production use.
source_info.license_or_terms: Open Government Data (OGD) India / Public Educational

columns.name: reported_input_cost_rs_per_ha
columns.description: Report-defined input cost; methodology is not inferred

data_quality_limitations: State-level summary only; not district or farm-specific cost data.
Input cost and value of output retain report-defined meanings and must not be relabeled as full cost, profit, or ROI.
Values are transcribed from report transcripts and have not been independently verified against the original reports.
The 2022-23 Beans/Summer summary has no reported cost or output value; those values remain blank.
processing_steps: Imported the supplied source CSV verbatim to data/raw/cultivation_cost/.
Validated the 11-column statewide summary schema before publishing canonical copies.
Kept the state summary separate from district-level itemized cultivation costs.
Recorded the source transcript verification caveat; no values were inferred or filled.
Cross-checked report-defined input cost and value of output against the original Kerala DES 2022-23 and 2023-24 report tables; the unreported 2022-23 Beans/Summer values remain blank.
cultivation_cost_summary.source_verification: Verified 34/34 reported 2022-23 and 35/35 reported 2023-24 input/output rows against original DES reports; zero mismatches.

market_arrivals.name: AGMARKNET Market Arrivals
market_arrivals.description: Market-reported physical commodity arrivals with the source unit retained.

source_info.organization: Directorate of Marketing & Inspection / AGMARKNET via data.gov.in
source_info.manual_export_instructions: Upload authentic Kerala AGMARKNET arrival records using the market_arrivals template. Keep the source arrival unit unchanged; do not infer a unit or demand from the quantity.
source_info.license_or_terms: Open Government Data (OGD) India / Public Educational

columns.name: arrival_unit
columns.description: Original unit reported by the source

data_quality_limitations: Arrival quantities are not converted; preserve and inspect each source unit before comparing records.
Market arrivals are physical quantities and must not be interpreted as consumer demand.
Only records with verifiable source, retrieval timestamp, and explicit arrival unit should be uploaded.

cultivation_cost_a.name: Kerala Statewide Cost A by Crop and Season
cultivation_cost_a.description: Kerala DES reported Cost A per hectare by crop/season and agricultural year.

source_info.organization: Department of Economics & Statistics, Government of Kerala
source_info.manual_export_instructions: Official Cost A table A5.1, printed page 264. Statewide Cost A is not district itemized total cost and is not a profitability input.
source_info.license_or_terms: Open Government Data (OGD) India / Public Educational

columns.name: cost_a_rs_per_hectare
columns.description: Kerala DES Cost A as printed in the source report

columns.name: source_verification_status
columns.description: Indicates direct comparison with the original official report

data_quality_limitations: Statewide Cost A per hectare only; it is not district-specific, full Cost C, total farmer cost, profit, or ROI.
All 108 zero values are preserved exactly as printed; they may indicate crops/years not covered or not reported and are not interpreted as zero cost.
This dataset must not be used to calculate farm or district profitability.
All 350 crop/season/year values were cross-checked against table A5.1 in the official Kerala DES 2023-24 report.
processing_steps: Downloaded and preserved the official Kerala DES 2023-24 report PDF.
Cross-checked all 350 crop/season/year Cost A values against table A5.1.
Normalized season and crop labels into separate fields; retained statewide resolution and source citation.
Retained all 108 source zeros as printed; no missing values were inferred or filled.
Kept Cost A separate from district itemized costs and excluded it from profitability calculations.
cultivation_cost_a.source_verification: 350 of 350 values matched official table A5.1; zero mismatches.
